# Terra Industries raises $18M, closing its $52 million seed round
## Terra’s defence-tech bet hits $52M
![Terra Inustries techpoint.africa](https://techpoint.africa/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Technician-with-Terra-logo-in-background-906x682.jpg.webp)Image source: Supplied

**Terra Industries** has just pulled off something pretty unusual in African startup funding: the Nigerian defence-tech startup has closed its $52 million seed round. The latest round builds on the [$11.75 million it raised in January 2026](https://techpoint.africa/insight/terra-raises-11-75-million/) and the [additional $22 million](https://techpoint.africa/insight/terra-valued-100-million-funding-34-million/) it secured in February, taking its total funding to $52 million.

Terra has already partnered with Nigeria’s armed forces, and its expansion into Ghana suggests it isn’t thinking of itself as just a Nigerian company. The $52 million seed round is therefore less about simply giving Terra more runway and more about giving an African defence-tech company the resources to manufacture, sell and deploy its technology at a continental scale.
